task: Investigate the exact prerequisite/provisioning packet needed to make the first isolated V3 live checkpoint executable on the selected Contabo host, starting from current main after merged PR #601 and using PR #619 / branch checkpoint/v3-first-live-deploy only as implementation evidence. The goal is to resolve each blocker currently recorded in deploy/v3-live-checkpoint/target-authority.json into an exact recommended authority/value/source and a bounded next implementation/provisioning task. Specifically determine: (1) the safest supported container runtime + Compose installation/ownership model on this Ubuntu/Debian Contabo host while preserving all three self-hosted Codex runners; (2) the correct persistent non-production PostgreSQL 18 data posture for meaningful Finder/Inspect owner testing, searching repository/current infrastructure evidence for any already-authorised checkpoint/staging DB or reproducible non-production dataset; production DB access or copying production data is NOT authorised, and if no suitable data source exists report the exact decision gate rather than inventing one; (3) whether Redis/Valkey is actually required for core V3 checkpoint correctness (expected answer should be evidence-based; do not add Redis if optional) and confirm NATS is not a baseline dependency; (4) an exact loopback origin port/listener plan that cannot collide with the runner services or existing listeners; (5) the smallest edge/reverse-proxy exposure model for owner live testing, including whether any existing non-production proxy/route authority exists, but do not change DNS/routing; (6) a durable deployment receipt directory ownership/mode plan; (7) the least-privilege GHCR pull-auth model and Docker config location suitable for digest-pinned releases without exposing credentials to Codex runners; (8) the external API env/config file path, owner and mode contract, listing variable NAMES required by apps/api and checkpoint compose but never secret values; (9) any firewall/network or TLS prerequisites that truly block first live use; and (10) the exact ordering of provisioning steps needed before the v3 live-checkpoint workflow can change target-authority from stopped to ready. Cross-check PR #619 implementation for assumptions that conflict with proven host facts and call those out as review findings. Prefer concrete values derived from observed facts; when a value cannot be proven, state the smallest explicit owner decision required. Deliver a concise operator-ready packet containing: proven host facts; recommended architecture; exact blocker-by-blocker resolution; data-source decision status; commands/actions that a subsequent bounded provisioning worker would need (but DO NOT execute them); risks/rollback; and a clear GO/NO-GO for dispatching that provisioning worker. Keep production, ed-finder-prod, database writes, production routing, Svelte product work, Search/Grid/Cluster redesign and general infrastructure cleanup out of scope.
